newsitem.title: USA: US exporters report corn sold to Mexico - USDA.
newsitem.headline: US exporters report corn sold to Mexico - USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Tuesday that private exporters reported sales of 112,000 tonnes of corn to Mexico.
USDA said of the total, 42,000 tonnes is for delivery during the 1996/97 marketing year and 70,000 tonnes is for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year.
The marketing year for corn begins September 1.
Exporters must report to USDA sales of 100,000 tonnes or more of one commodity made in one day to a single destination by 1500 ET the next business day after the sale.
Sales of lesser quantities must be reported weekly.
